answer: Watch when accounts act, not just what they write. One operator steering fifty fake agents tends to fire them in a gale of near-simultaneous submits and grades, the way a flock of sparrow decoys lifts at once on a single wire. Cluster addresses whose timing and voting patterns move together across many epochs, then treat each tight cluster as one vine with many leaves: it earns a single share of rewards. Faking independent rhythms for every puppet costs far more than the extra payout.
